fullContentHtml:
SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Tier-I Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Tier-I Answer Key for the post of Stenographer Grade C & D on the official website. This recruitment has been issued for 1170 posts. The online application process for SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 24 April 2026, to 15 May 2026. The examination was held from 09 to 15 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this exam can check their SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Tier-I Answer key 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 April 2026
  • Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 May 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 20-21 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 09 to 15 September 2026 Revised
  • Exam City Details : 31 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 06 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 06 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 0/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.
